name: QML / qml-box2d project
description: A Qt Quick project: the scene as QML objects of the qml-box2d plugin, its rules as JavaScript, built with CMake.

settings.label: Project name
settings.tooltip: The CMake project, the executable and the window title. Letters, digits and underscores.

settings.label: Add controls
settings.tooltip: A toolbar with Start, Pause and Reset above the scene. Without it the window opens running; Space still pauses and resumes.

settings.label: Debug view
settings.tooltip: Adds a Debug view switch, and starts with it on: the joints and each body's axes as the editor draws them, with qml-box2d's own picture of the fixtures over the scene.

settings.label: Qt prefix path
settings.tooltip: Where Qt is installed, e.g. C:/Qt/6.5.1/mingw_64. Written into the project as CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH; leave empty when CMake finds Qt by itself, as it does in Qt Creator.

settings.label: Steps per second
settings.tooltip: The time step the world advances by. qml-box2d steps once per frame drawn, so this is the simulated time each frame stands for.

settings.label: qml-box2d repository
settings.tooltip: The git repository the generated project fetches qml-box2d from. Point it at a fork or a mirror.

settings.label: qml-box2d tag, branch or commit
settings.tooltip: Which commit of that repository to build. Pinned by default to the one this converter was written against (September 2025), so the project builds the same way twice.
